concerns.text: The plan states that no open dataset provides experimental permeability coefficients and therefore pivots to predicting the calculated `logP` value as a proxy target. This means the dataset(s) cited (e.g., ChEMBL‑derived RDKit descriptors) do not contain the required permeability measurements, violating FR‑001 which requires ingestion of public permeability datasets. Using `logP` as a proxy makes the dataset inappropriate for answering the core research question of predicting molecular permeability coefficients.
